name: pi
description: The pi coding agent (Mario Zechner's @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent) running headless in the sandbox. One Responses request is one pi turn: the input is pi's prompt, pi talks to the provider through the gateway, and pi's JSON event stream is mapped to Responses events. Sessions are pi's own under ~/.pi/agent/sessions, resumed by id, with the platform history as fallback.
